overview.description: The ProShares UltraShort MSCI Japan (EWV) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the MSCI Japan index. The fund provides 2x inverse exposure to the MSCI Japan Index, which covers approximately 85% of the float-adjusted market cap of the Japanese equity market. EWV was launched on Nov 6, 2007 and is issued by ProShares.
